structured.feedback: Good enough to ship. All six fields are present and accurate, there's no PII (no names, ages or dates), and each bullet uses the key: value format and ends with a period. Minor issues: it runs about 180 words against the ~150 target, it uses bold markdown, it adds the unchanged current medications after N/A, and it repeats the transcript's error "clear to oscillation" instead of "clear to auscultation".
